title: quarkus-messaging-kafka (Kotlin) – Error MetadataExtensions: Provider JvmMetadataExtensions not found in 3.26.4 and lower (works in <= 3.20.2 LTS)
body:
### Describe the bug

When using Kotlin with quarkus-messaging-kafka, sending a message to Kafka fails on Quarkus 3.26.4 with an error related to the Kotlin reflection / Jackson Kotlin module.
This issue does not occur on 3.20.2 LTS, so it seems to be a regression introduced between these versions.


```
@ApplicationScoped
class AgentService {

    @Inject
    @Channel("agents")
    lateinit var resources: MutinyEmitter<OnEventStoreMessage>

    fun onJoined(event: OnAgentJoined): Uni<Void> {
        return resources.send(
            OnEventStoreAgentConnected(event.agent.id.serial, event.since)
        )
    }
}
```



### Expected behavior

SRMSG18211: Message org.eclipse.microprofile.reactive.messaging.Message$5@240e4074 from channel 'agents' sent successfully to Kafka topic-partition 'xxxxx-prd-hexa-agents-0', with offset 1400
